definitions: A male given name, pet form of Busby

blocks.text: Buzz is a nickname. Notable people with the name include:

Herbert Altshuler, American retired major general
Buzz Arlett (1899–1964), American baseball player
James D. Beans, United States Marine Corps brigadier general
